description: The receipt the page side returns for a seam install phase. This is ghl_external_installer's provenance receipt shape (RECEIPT_SCHEMA '1.0') carried across unchanged, extended only with brief_binding (which brief this receipt answers) and urls (preview/public per page). Completion is judged by ghl_external_installer.validate_receipt's rules (schema version, run/location binding, durable ops-ledger provenance with matching execution_id and remote ids, readback per page, non-stale input hashes) PLUS the brief binding: brief_binding must name the CURRENT emitted brief for each page the phase answers, with the brief file's exact sha256. A receipt answering a superseded brief is stale. Status 'pending_external_execution' never completes. Defined here so Item 21 builds against a fixed contract; page_brief.py does not build the consumer.

artifact.description: Gate pair receipts only: the receipt's own run-relative path.

brief_binding.description: The seam extension: which emitted brief(s) this receipt answers. P-U-GHL-SALES binds the sales AND checkout briefs (one funnel install); P-U-GHL-VSL and P-U-FORM-GATE bind the vsl brief.

sha256.description: sha256 of the emitted brief FILE, exactly as written.

execution_id.description: 'gx_' + 12 hex chars; must trace to a real adapter execution in this run's durable ops ledger (working/checkpoints/ghl_external_ops.json) with the same remote ids.

input_hashes.description: Run-relative path -> sha256 for the phase's input files, plus the key 'intake'. Must be present and non-stale vs the current inputs or re-install is required; a receipt with no input hashes can never complete.

plan.description: Page phases only, on pending receipts: the run-relative path of the install plan this receipt answers.

readback.description: Page phases: {ok, checked_at, pages: {page_id: {page_id, funnel_id, location_id, version, draft, slug}}}. Gate pair: {ok, checked_at, form: {form_id, location_id, workflow_ids, http}, workflow: {workflow_id, form_id, location_id, draft, http}}.

remote.description: Page phases: {funnel_id, sales_page_id, checkout_page_id} or {funnel_id, vsl_page_id}. Gate phase: this receipt is a PAIR (ecosystem/gate-form.json carries remote {form_id}; workflows/gate-workflow.json carries remote {workflow_id}), each receipt also carrying its own 'artifact' path field.

location_id.description: Must match the bound location when one is bound (WRONG_LOCATION otherwise).

run_id.description: Must equal the run folder name.

status.description: Complete set: verified, complete. pending_external_execution never completes.

urls.description: Per-page URLs the page side returns, keyed by page id (the Skill 71 receipt pattern: install receipts carry the structured install block, publish-verify carries public_url). Optional in the base provenance shape; required by the seam for any page the receipt claims as installed.

title: Page seam receipt (FIX-PLAN Item 20 contract; the consumer is Item 21)
